name: Croque
quote: The gears were in perfect alignment, and the warriors stood their ground.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Ah. G'morning.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: It's afternoon.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: It's getting dark and I'm still not done with the repairs.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: The late-night anime, Metal Suit Gamma is starting soon. Ah. Professor, are you going to watch it with me?

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: I'm on a mission. Leave me alone.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: The sound of machines moving and gears gnashing, I can never have enough of that, ehehehe...

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: You've fallen asleep...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Professor... Can I go back to my room? It's too bright out here.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Huh?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Stop it...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Ugh. What a hassle...

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Croque, mechanical engineer, reporting for duty. Oh, don't mind me. A seat in the corner will be just fine.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: My tasks are done.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: I should be able to repair more complex machines now.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Once you've got an understanding of basic mechanics, the rest all comes naturally.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Ready to go.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Aegis activated.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Alright punks, show me what you've got!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: Battle finished.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: Threat extermination complete.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: It's not over yet...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: An oath...? W-what did you just say?! So if I agree to it, I'll be able to watch anime all night long with you every day...!? Then if everything goes well, perhaps I can turn you into an anime otaku too... Hehehe. Then I'll never run out of topics with you.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year. Do you need me for anything? If not, I'll be leaving...

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Here, some motor oil and rubber flavored chocolates that I made by hand... Eh? Why do you look so pale?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: This watermelon seems to have grown horns... How about we name it "Green Meteor"? This ought to move 3 times faster than ordinary watermelons, according to the lore.

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: This pumpkin's shape looks exactly like Eismma, the villain robot from Metal Suit Gamma. Eismma is legendary for taking on three main characters all on its own.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: I'm not going to the Christmas party unless there's a limited edition Metal Suit figure in it for me... Oh. I'll take back what I just said. Professor, how did you get your hands on this!?

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Hmm... I have no idea what to get you. How about... we watch anime together? We can spend a nice, lazy day inside.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: Professor... What do you need? If you have nothing to say, I'm returning to my work. Huh? You need my help with some paperwork? Please no...

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Erm... Well, I'm just taking a small rest. Working continuously over a long time can cause irreversible damage to my Neural Cloud. By the way, Professor, have you ever watched Super Alloy Demon God Haryuumaru?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: I don't really like talking to people. I prefer to stay at home and build plastic models, or mess around with my Gilbert's Atomic Energy Lab set. Those are my only hobbies really.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: Professor, you want us to go for a walk together? Hehe. Somehow I'm feeling happy about it... Should we go shopping?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text: Professor, let's go check on the latest plastic models in the electronics quarter together once we return to the real world. This is a secret promise, only between the two of us... If you back out, I'll have you know I'm awfully good at bonking people with my wrench.

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hehe.

career:
ME78, an engineer Doll designed by Svarog Heavy Industries CEO Elon Thomas in July 2056, is a member of Svarog Heavy Industries' Core Engineering Department and has participated in a range of cutting-edge research projects.

42Lab and Svarog Heavy Industries reached an initial agreement in January 2058 to collaborate on the first batch of high-tech talents. Croque joined Project Neural Cloud as the key engineer for Svarog Heavy Industries.
infoStories:
Everyone's first impression of Croque is that she's cold and disinterested, or to be more exact, the epitome of the stereotype of all engineers. Croque is completely uninterested in everything but mechanics. When she starts working, she loses track of time.

She despises being interrupted while working, even if the supposed guests are her close friends. In that case, she would simply shift her attitude from harsh to indifferent.

Most of the time, Croque only speaks to her simulated consciousness, that which implies she no longer has time for nonsense and is now fully dedicated to her work.

Although Croque may seem aloof and icy at work, she is quite easy to get along with if you hold an expertise in mechanical engineering and vast knowledge regarding mecha-themed works.

Croque is a well-known toy model collector at Svarog Heavy Industries. In her dorm, she has an entire wall of models and figurines from all of the mecha animation movies available on the market.

There was a time where Croque's hobby even caused an issue for Svarog Heavy Industries' legal department. Croque painted a new military mech with the same coating as one from an animated film, which was spotted by a fan when it was on exhibit. It led to a nonsensical legal battle.

Croque's specialties are not just limited to military mechanical engineering. In fact, she is the chief engineer behind Svarog Heavy Industries' energy core project—"Noah's Reactor".

Under Croque's guidance, Svarog Heavy Industries' Core Engineering Department made 16 technological discoveries and completed the reactor's research two months ahead of time, which accelerated the research development of other energy projects.

As a result, Croque and her team rose to the top of the field, collecting multiple accolades from the International Mechanical Engineering Association.

Croque's shapeshifting shield, "Aegis", was once a prototype for Svarog Heavy Industries' next-generation mech weapon used in military bids. Aegis can change shape in comparison to other competing products, providing unrivaled battle versatility.

The intricate structure utilized for shapeshifting, on the other hand, comes at a high expense. Putting cost to effectiveness first, the military buyer eventually settled on "Minotaur", a product of another military supplier, Sangvis Ferri.

As a top-rate mechanical engineer, Croque saw a great deal of modification potential in Aegis. She reinforced Aegis with a slew of practical features, transforming it into a one-of-a-kind combat shield that combines beauty and functionality.

Croque feels at home in the Oasis. She doesn't agree with the Wipe-off Incident, but she does want to stay in Magrasea, because she can do whatever she wants in here instead of adhering to the engineering department's research agenda.

Croque's time in the Oasis has been filled with numerous creative ideas, making it her most prolific period for research and invention. Most importantly, she is not required to submit a report for her research!

Croque's sole complaint about the Oasis is that she can no longer view the latest anime series. Yes, she can restore past episodes from her database, but the thrill of following the latest episodes can never be replicated. She has to give up her passion for watching anime and devote all of her unsatisfied energy to work.
oathDesc: Thank you, Professor. Now I can fight properly again.

projections.name: Special Engineer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"With each additional unit of Operand acquired, the Aegis Shield becomes a little heavier. To protect the Oasis, she firmly holds on to that heavy weight."

projections.name: Special Engineer
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"With each additional unit of Operand acquired, the Aegis Shield becomes a little heavier. To protect the Oasis, she firmly holds on to that heavy weight."

projections.name: Svarog Mechanic
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"It's wonderful how Dolls are more or less somewhere between being a human or a machine. How is a Doll supposed to think of itself, then?"

skinList.name: Initium Mechanica
skinList.desc: The first awakening of a Doll has the same level of importance as birth to a human being. Memories are reproduced in Magrasea via Neural Cloud Projection—"I work well with these tools, and with them I can better assist you. Also, may I stay alone in the studio?"

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
The Dolls reveal their true natures by accident, and take new forms with the aid of a mysterious power. Where truth and falsehood intersect, beware drowning in a fool's game.
"Hehehe, time for my strongest form. I'll form the head!"

skinList.name: Pastel Skyfarer
skinList.desc:
"Childlike Fantasies" Series — Croque's appearance in the picture books. Between complex blueprints and exquisite workmanship, the young inventor takes to the skies, chasing the dreams and the skies above with crayon in hand.
"You want to go to Lapda? Let's go together after I finish drawing up this glider."

skinList.name: Lunar Metal Suit MK-2
skinList.desc:
Snowy Spring — A special outfit that the Dolls wear during the Chinese New Year garden party. Bid farewell to the old and liven up the new with a splash of unique scenery.
"This is a special limited edition early-spring armor set! It might sacrifice some defense, but it's no biggie so long as you don't get hit! Ah~ I've always wanted to say that. Hm? Professor? How long were you watching me?"

skinList.name: Heartfelt Projection
skinList.desc:
A scene that transcribes you and me into 1s and 0s, separated by nothing more than a processor cycle. This ripple within our neural clouds is a memory that can never be reset.
"Handsaws, screwdrivers and forges are all part of the romance of industry; naturally, chocolate has to be at least that romantic too."

skinList.name: Oasis Guarding Girl
skinList.desc: The surging fighting spirit that swells between each intense battle is what keeps each Doll going until the very end. Be it on the attack or defense, no matter how good or bad the situation is, their memories have been reproduced in Magrasea through this projection. Even if everything lies in ruins, it's not the time to give up! I want to live! I want to protect everyone! Almighty Mecha! Heed my will... Wait! Why is the cockpit actually glowing?!

skinList.name: Hardcore Jellybean
skinList.desc:
Revel in a rare moment of relaxation on a sunny, lazy afternoon. As you open the door, the sugary scent of leisure hits you.
Even on weekends, Croque tirelessly draws up blueprints in her bedroom—how should she proceed with this next step of her mecha assembly? She appears to be a little confounded.
